Change ONLY colors: gold ribbon and Flow should use #FEBE10 with restrained tonal gold shading; every blue/navy internal ribbon fold becomes neutral night-black/charcoal #1A1A1A with subtle gray shading, absolutely no blue. Preserve white Fixx and wrench and light-gray IT SUPPORT IN MOTION tagline. Preserve exact shapes, letterforms, layout, proportions, and all genuine alpha transparency around the logo and between letters. Smooth crisp edges, no splatter, no fringe, no opaque backdrop, no checkerboard. Deliver transparent PNG.

derivatives: Navigation mark, horizontal lockups, source masters, app icons, Apple/Android icons and ICO share the gold-and-night-black palette. Application logos retain their exact prior alpha channels.
darkArtwork: All application logo variants retain their original alpha channels exactly. No background or backing plaque is introduced. Internal folds use neutral charcoal; launcher icons retain their intentional square background.
